description: Big explosion at an object: sounds, ground scorch decal, shock wave/flash/smoke/sparks, debris, light, hit effects and blast damage

Beam object update: lifetime, re-attach to followed character matrix, retarget/raycast, move head, impact

Returns its first argument unchanged (stub handler)

Message handler stub that forwards to beam_effect_stub

Zap bolt update: life countdown, chase target/path, spawn lightning segments from anchor and sparks

Spawns a short type-0x33 emitter object with fixed rate parameters

Point burst update: spawns sprite particles randomly within 20 units of its point
Spawns a short type-0x36 emitter object with fixed rate parameters

Spawns a sprite flash, 5..12 flying physics sparks and a short light at a point

Wrapper calling weather_lightning_storm_update (argument ignored)

Emitter update: spawns moving lights that sweep between random points on two segments at a random speed

Gets foot 1/2 bone position (bones 0x21 / 0x1D) and optionally probes the ground just below it

Spawns an impact dust particle at the given foot's ground point, scaled by the object's speed

Adds an offset to a position and runs target_volume_hit_check on the result
Tests a point/sphere against target trigger volumes; on a target hit fires its event and explodes it; returns 1 on hit
Spring-driven tilt angle of a world object toward -40 (or player-distance based), released into a fall state
Fireworks burst: sound, flash and light at fixed points, then four spark showers with random launch velocities
Explodes at a trigger volume record: debris emitter, rumble, sound and two stacked flash/smoke/light effects
Fires barrel 0/1 of a gun object: aim ray, tracer toward the hit point, muzzle flash and barrel smoke
Tracer hit filter: true for live objects other than self whose type is 0-4, 0x28 or 0x77
Calls func_151C40BC with white (1, 1, 1, 0) and full bytes
Emitter update: unless its area is hidden, spawns type-0x5A effect objects at random points of the area
Emitter update: at a random rate spawns particles (func_151307F0) at its stored point
Spawns a type-0x5D effect object that keeps a colour overlay (RGBA + mode) on a character for a time
Message handler of the tint effect: forwards to node_handle_link_message for its linked object
Tint effect update: re-applies the colour overlay (func_1502ED88) to its object; ends if the object is gone
Calls func_151CA070 on an object and gives it a green colour overlay effect (mode 4)

Signed difference b - a of two angles in degrees, normalised into (-180, 180]
Signed angle between an object's heading and the direction to another object (degrees)
Ballistic aim helper of the tank turret: horizontal miss distance (or elevation error) of a shell toward a point
Sets the driver's camera bit in +0x2FC when the driver part allows and the player has the view flag 0x10
Clamps left/right track speeds to +-45 and sets the two track texture scroll rates
Per-frame update of a drivable tank: driver input, boost, steering, AI, physics, hit reactions, tracks and turret aim
State table entry: puts the tank in state 3 and hands the rider's camera/controls back to its player
State handler: enters state 3 once (stop sound/anim), then runs the object physics
Unless masked by the object's flags, starts the bone tether effect and spawns a flash and spark burst at the bone point
Broadcasts message 0x43 with the object and side to the effect lists to stop its tether
Starts a bone-to-object beam effect with two flame sprites, a glow, a smoke emitter and a light; returns the effect
Beam update: follows source bone to target object, pulses width/alpha, moves its light and ray casts to tint hit objects
Filter callback: true when the object's type byte is 0x28
Destroys the tether's flame sprites, glow, smoke and light nodes and retires the effect
Deletes the tether's flame sprites, glow, smoke and light nodes and frees the effect

Flame sprite update: copies the beam's endpoints and bone point while the beam is valid, else hides it; returns 1
Emitter update: while the tether beam is valid spawns streak particles with random launch directions
Starts a 30-tick smoke particle emitter of a given colour bound to an object and effect

Creates a point light of a given colour bound to the tether effect

Flame sprite free hook: clears its slot in the tether effect
Clears the tether effect's pointer to this flame sprite (slot +0x12C[n])

Clears the tether's glow pointer and frees the glow node
Clears the tether effect's glow pointer (+0x134)

Clears the tether's smoke pointer and deletes the emitter buffers
Clears the tether effect's smoke emitter pointer (+0x138)

Clears the tether's light pointer and frees the light controller
Clears the tether effect's light pointer (+0x13C)

Smoke emitter message handler: ends on owner removal, re-points its object on swap (0x2D)
Creates two joint lights on an object (joints 0x25 and 2) with fixed parameters
Spawns a spark burst effect (func_151530A8) at a point
Spawns a glow effect 0x2B at an object's position remembering the object and three random phases
Glow update: follows its object and pulses its two sizes and alpha; ends when the object is gone
Glow message handler: re-points on object swap (0x2D), ends on owner removal or stop (0x43)
Spawns a type-0x4C effect object with a 0x18-byte record (object, target point) at +0x28
Emitter update: while its object lives spawns particles along the object-to-point segment
Effect message handler: ends on 0x43 from its target, else forwards to func_15149514
Light message handler: ends on 0x43 from its target object

Breathing scale of object type 0x7B: advances a shared phase (speed by +0x2E4 flags) and scales a model matrix
Swings a shared angle down/up by object state 0x21 and writes six joint adjustment entries (joints 29..34)
Sets object type 0x7B animation bytes +0x68/+0x69 from its state (0x14) and +0x2E4 flag pairs
Big explosion effects at an object: shock wave, flash, smoke, sound 0x2B6/0x2BE, light, debris and fragments
Random ambient sound 0x6C..0x6E with a cooldown while the object is far from the origin
Spawns a smoke puff at a random point within 100 of an object's bone (+0x4C0) unless its +0x74 nibble is 0xF

Footstep surface callback that always returns surface 0xE
Spawns a dust/smoke puff at the tip of an object's leg (obj_leg_tip_pos)

Swing block update: sets two angles from sine phases times amplitudes and advances the phases; returns 1
Builds this frame's matrix from the swing block's two angles and pivot position; returns 1

Drop sprite draw entry: builds its quad via sprite_quad_build_axes from the stored axes

Player swim state 0x15 update: stick steering, pitch, speed, carry/drop/pick-up objects, surfacing and animation

Destroys the emitter's children and frees it (func_15149368)
